answer: Attackers forging N identities must acquire N distinct devices and pass N liveness checks, making the marginal cost per fake identity exceed the reward from any single epoch, much like carving a marble replica for every counterfeit coin. Sybil resistance can be anchored on a proof-of-personhood vertex: each agent must bind one unique hardware root key to a signed attestation, and the network admits only one identity per attested vertex. A raven-like audit layer randomly challenges a sample each round, slashing unverified duplicates. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
